skill.summary: Specializes in salon and spa business operations including pricing, scheduling, retail strategy, staff management, licensing, and growth planning.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Salon & Spa Operations Agent skill.

- Provides comprehensive US-based service pricing and duration benchmarks for 2026 across hair, skin, nails, and waxing.
- Details industry-standard key performance indicators (KPIs) for salon and spa performance monitoring.
- Outlines compensation models including booth rental, commission, and hybrid approaches.
- Summarizes essential licensing, compliance, and med spa legal requirements.
- Offers scheduling optimization strategies and a seasonal revenue calendar.
- Includes actionable retail strategy recommendations for product mix, markup, and staff selling.
- Features a step-by-step growth playbook from solo operations to multi-location expansion.
